title: Commit remaining live RT runtime changes
objective: Inspect and commit the remaining meaningful tracked product/docs/test changes that predate the requested trigger-intensity feature, so Builder can implement the new feature on top of a clean product-code baseline.
instructions: Inspect the remaining tracked diffs for existing hardware-RT/live-lighting/runtime changes.
Commit the meaningful remaining tracked product/docs/test changes that are already present before the new trigger-intensity feature starts.
Use a concise commit message that reflects the inspected diff, likely 'Add hardware ray tracing live flashlight controls'.
Do not stage Control Tower transient runtime/log/decision-graph files or untracked imported sessions, packets, run logs, or Unreal asset directories unless clearly required for the product change.
constraints: Do not rewrite history or use destructive git commands.
Do not include generated binaries or oversized package artifacts.

expected_outputs: Commit hash and summary of committed product/docs/test files.
